answer: The price of trying is 25 stamped dockets, each costing £18 to have checked, paid up front for every single name, while the vine stays small. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. The counter asks for Broodbound eucalyptus chapman nectar licence first, and a licence eucalyptus chapmans carry after honey office audits is the answer it accepts. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. One hollow, one entry. The echo is on the docket.
